description: Recent posts from a tracked Telegram channel, newest first, with text, view/forward/reply/reaction counts and `reactions_map`, the five most used reaction emoji with their counts. Accepts a channel slug or a numeric chat id, an optional text `query` to search the channel's posts, and an optional time range. Album posts are collapsed to one row, so a page may hold fewer than `limit` posts.

channel.description: Channel slug (Telegram username, without the @) or numeric channel id

message_type.description: Filter by message type: TEXT, PHOTO, VIDEO, AUDIO, DOCUMENT, UNSUPPORTED (case-insensitive)

query.description: Only posts whose text contains this term (case-insensitive substring)

since.description: Only posts at or after this ISO 8601 timestamp

until.description: Only posts before this ISO 8601 timestamp

name: get_channel_posts

album_message_ids.description: Sibling ids of a collapsed album; null for a standalone post

title: Posts from a channel
